subject: Scaling Graymatics, Inc.'s ML pipeline
text:
Hi Abhijit,

Thought our upcoming session on AI-powered smart city infrastructure could be interesting for Graymatics, Inc..

On 30 September, Friedrich Münke, Director of Data Science at vialytics, will share his experience scaling ML pipeline to power the future of smart cities.

In this practical 45-minute session, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at how vialytics:
Unified a fragmented ML pipeline into a single scalable data layer. Tripled dataset sizes and increased data diversity to improve model performance. Applied human-in-the-loop systems to enhance label quality and tackle rare edge cases. Whether you're scaling your own ML pipelines or looking to improve data workflows, this session is packed with real-world lessons you can bring to your next team meeting.

Save your spot here: https://encord.com/webinar/vialytics-smart-cities/?utm_source=sequences&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=hubspot.

Best wishes,
Chloe

subject: Boost performance for AI model & Active tracking in Live Sports Broadcasts
text:
Hi John,

I was watching the US Open and noticed how seamless the real-time visuals
are that SMT’s been adding to the game. Thought I’d reach out since we work
with Hudl, SwingVision, Spiideo and Veo on similar CV challenges in sports
data and live broadcast.

We’ve mainly helped them improve model accuracy & delivery speed by
providing an infrastructure for high quality video annotation, which solved
challenges around player tracking, ball flight, broadcast overlays while
keeping development cost under control.

Quick context on Encord: we’re a data development platform that helps CV
teams curate, annotate, QA, and evaluate models in one place. We help with
native video annotation across complex, high-speed, multi-angle footage, so
the teams focus more on improving the shows fans love.

We’d love to share what’s been working for others in your space. Do you
have 20mins to chat? Wednesdays/Thursdays PT work best for us.

Best,

Laura

safety critical use cases like navigation, driver safety, and curbside
logistics.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV
